name: Animatek
author: Animatek
tagline: The ATEK303 acid voice on the M-VAVE FM-1
description: ATEK303 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a TB-303 voice: the ATEK303 engine from VCV Rack, with its diode ladder and its oscillator modelled on the schematic, played from the keys or over MIDI.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Hügelton Instruments). The voice is ATEK303 by Animatek, on Open303 by Robin Schmidt.
